overview_description.description: ​Allia Health provides a digital platform for mental health professionals, integrating tools for client onboarding, scheduling, treatment planning, and progress tracking. The platform features secure, HIPAA-compliant telehealth services with AI-assisted documentation to streamline clinical workflows. It collects real-world data through client check-ins, symptom tracking, and optional wearable integrations, offering clinicians insights into patient progress between sessions. Allia Health operates on a model where individual clinicians access the platform at no cost, while larger healthcare organizations pay for enterprise features and analytics. The platform is accessible via iOS, Android, and web applications.

about_short_description.short_description: Alliauk is a patient management platform that uses AI for mental health insights.

product.name: Allia Patient Management Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform that supports mental health clinicians by managing patient data, streamlining administrative tasks, and providing AI-driven insights to inform clinical decisions.

product.name: Built-In Telehealth
product.description: A telehealth feature integrated into the Allia platform that enables remote mental health consultations between clinicians and patients.

product.name: Seamless Onboarding
product.description: A streamlined onboarding process within the Allia platform that simplifies patient registration and integration into clinical workflows.

product.name: Integrated Insights
product.description: An AI-driven analytics feature that provides mental health clinicians with actionable insights derived from patient data to support clinical decision-making.

product.name: Effortless Documentation
product.description: A documentation tool within the Allia platform that simplifies the creation and management of clinical notes and records for mental health providers.
